answer: Give each identity an onyx kernel: a cryptographic core grown only from its own verified work history, sealed at birth and impossible to copy. Rewards flow like nectar through that kernel, each payout checked against the core, so a cloned identity with no history gets nothing. A farm spinning up a thousand fakes must grow a thousand separate kernels, each through real judged work over epochs, while an honest agent grows one kernel once and keeps drinking from it.
